product_overview: Karen is a privacy-first, empathetic emotional support backend that combines real-time NLP analysis with Google Gemini to guide users through difficult conversations. It supports authenticated chat, emotion/severity/topic classification, session history tracking, and structured handoff reports without storing raw transcripts on the server.
core_goals: Provide warm, grounded conversational support through an AI companion persona
Detect emotion, distress, and crisis signals in user messages using ML pipelines
Maintain a zero-knowledge architecture where raw transcripts stay on the client device
Secure all user-specific actions with JWT authentication and hashed email identity
Persist only anonymized session metadata, emotion arcs, and structured summaries for history and handoff
Offer safety-focused escalation and crisis guidance when distress thresholds are met

features.name: System Health & Status
features.description: Allows clients and monitoring systems to confirm that the API is running and healthy.
user_flows: GET / -> Receive 200 with message confirming the API is running -> GET /health -> Receive 200 with service status and health state
GET /health -> Receive 200 with service status for monitoring -> GET / -> Receive 200 with API running message
GET /health on an unavailable service -> Receive non-200 or no response indicating the service is down

features.name: User Authentication
features.description: Enables new users to register and returning users to log in with email and password, returning JWT access tokens and a hashed user identifier.
user_flows: POST /api/v1/auth/register with valid email and password -> Receive 201 with access_token, token_type, and user_hash -> Use returned token for authenticated API requests
POST /api/v1/auth/login with valid credentials -> Receive 200 with access_token, token_type, and user_hash -> Access protected endpoints using the JWT
POST /api/v1/auth/register with an email that already exists -> Receive 409 with detail explaining the account conflict
POST /api/v1/auth/login with invalid credentials -> Receive 401 with detail indicating authentication failure

features.name: Conversational Chat & Guidance
features.description: Processes authenticated support conversations, runs ML analysis on each turn, and generates an empathetic response with escalation flags.
user_flows: POST /api/v1/chat/message with session_id, messages array, and is_first_message=true using a valid JWT -> Receive 200 with response, ml_signals, escalate, crisis, and session_id -> Continue conversation with subsequent POST /api/v1/chat/message turns
POST /api/v1/chat/message with valid JWT and emotionally intense text -> Receive 200 with ml_signals showing high severity -> Receive escalate=true or crisis=true when thresholds are met
POST /api/v1/chat/end-session with valid JWT and session_id, topic, and final_severity -> Receive 200 with status confirming the session ended
POST /api/v1/chat/message without a valid JWT -> Receive 401 with detail indicating unauthorized access
POST /api/v1/chat/message with malformed or missing session data -> Receive 400 with detail describing the bad request

features.name: Machine Learning Standalone Analysis
features.description: Provides authenticated endpoints to test emotion classification, severity assessment, and topic categorization independently of the chat flow.
user_flows: POST /api/v1/ml/emotion with text and valid JWT -> Receive 200 with dominant_emotion and probability scores
POST /api/v1/ml/severity with text and valid JWT -> Receive 200 with severity, score, escalate, and crisis flags
POST /api/v1/ml/topic with text and valid JWT -> Receive 200 with topic and confidence score
POST /api/v1/ml/emotion without a valid JWT -> Receive 401 with detail indicating unauthorized access
POST /api/v1/ml/severity with text that implies crisis -> Receive 200 with crisis=true and escalate=true when threshold conditions are met

features.name: Session History & Emotion Tracking
features.description: Lets authenticated users retrieve prior session metadata and emotion progression summaries without exposing raw transcripts.
user_flows: GET /api/v1/history/sessions with a valid JWT -> Receive 200 with an array of recent session metadata -> Select a session and call GET /api/v1/history/sessions/{session_id} -> Receive 200 with detailed metadata and emotion arc
GET /api/v1/history/sessions/{session_id} with a valid JWT -> Receive 200 with session details and chronological emotion tracking
GET /api/v1/history/sessions with no or invalid JWT -> Receive 401 with detail indicating unauthorized access
GET /api/v1/history/sessions/{session_id} for a session not owned by the user or not found -> Receive error response indicating the session cannot be accessed

features.name: Session Report Generation
features.description: Generates a structured JSON handoff report from client-provided session transcript and metadata for sharing with a counselor or clinician.
user_flows: POST /api/v1/report/generate with valid JWT, session_id, messages array, topic, emotion_arc, and final_severity -> Receive 200 with session_id and structured report object -> Render or export the report as a client-side PDF

POST /api/v1/report/generate with valid JWT and a complete transcript -> Receive 200 with a report containing presenting concern, emotional tone, key themes, directions given, risk flags, and recommendation
POST /api/v1/report/generate without a valid JWT -> Receive 401 with detail indicating unauthorized access
POST /api/v1/report/generate without the required messages array or session metadata -> Receive error response indicating the report cannot be generated
